views.en: In 2025, he framed ephemerality and authentic camera communication as Snapchat's core, predicting glasses would replace screens by keeping users present.
views.zh: 2025年，他把‘阅后即焚’与真实的镜头交流视为Snapchat核心，并预言眼镜会让用户留在现实、取代屏幕。

views.en: Between 2025 and 2026, he moved from 'platform not feature' to emphasizing distribution as hardest; software isn't a moat—ecosystems and hardware are.
views.zh: 2025到2026年，他的策略从‘做平台而非功能’转向强调分发最难；软件不是护城河，生态与硬件才是。

views.en: By 2026, he saw AI writing two-thirds of Snap's code and making software creation easier—so human authenticity, EQ, and distribution gained value.
views.zh: 到2026年，他认为AI已编写Snap三分之二新代码、让软件创作更容易，因此人的真实内容、情商与分发能力更有价值。

views.en: By 2026, his AR vision matured: glasses shouldn't be notification devices but anchor content in the world; smartphones remain, with computing made more human.
views.zh: 到2026年，他的AR愿景成熟：眼镜不应是通知设备，而应把内容锚定在世界中；智能手机仍在，计算需更以人为本。

views.en: In 2026, he reflected that early secrecy at Snap was a huge mistake; quickly changing one's mind, persistence, and kindness enable innovation.
views.zh: 2026年他反思，早期保密是巨大错误；快速认错改变、坚持不放弃，以及友善文化才是创新关键。

views.en: Argued model usefulness bottleneck is continual learning; memory should be internalized into weights, making many personalized models rather than one giant model.
views.zh: 2026年6月，他认为模型实用性的瓶颈在于持续学习；记忆应内化进权重，未来是众多个性化模型而非单一巨型模型。

views.en: Criticized context windows as inefficient and 'context rot'; internalizing knowledge in weights enables associative recall and deeper reasoning beyond RAG.
views.zh: 从6月到7月，他持续批判上下文窗口的低效与“上下文腐化”，主张将知识内化进权重，以实现检索系统无法实现的联想式召回与深层推理。

views.en: Framed efficiency and intelligence as inseparable; future enterprise-scale data demands training-based compression and personalized on-device continual learning beyond scaling compute.
views.zh: 2026年7月，他将效率与智能视为一体两面，认为未来企业级规模数据需要基于训练的压缩与端侧个性化持续学习，而非单纯靠算力扩张。

Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Culture and Engineering Transformation

views.en: Starts with cultural turnaround: rebuilding customer trust, engineering discipline like first-time-pass silicon, and defining an AI strategy with purpose-built chips; identifies physical and agentic AI as next waves.
views.zh: 2025年：以文化转型起步——重建客户信任、强调工程纪律（如一次流片成功），并提出以专用芯片重定义AI战略；率先指出物理AI与智能体式AI是下一波浪潮。

views.en: Deepens the turnaround playbook: argues AI's impact exceeds the internet, prioritizes agentic and physical AI, and stresses humility and fast information flow; insists the real problem is supply, not demand.
views.zh: 2026年初：深化扭亏方法论——认为AI影响将超过互联网，聚焦智能体式AI与物理AI，强调谦逊和坏消息快速上行；坚持英特尔的问题是供给而非需求。

views.en: Shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes crucial for AI inference and agent orchestration. Calls for government stakeholding, balance-sheet repair, and bets on advanced packaging and new materials.
views.zh: 2026年中：从纯GPU转向CPU+GPU，认为CPU对AI推理与智能体编排至关重要；主张政府入股、修复资产负债表，并押注先进封装与玻璃/钻石等新材料。

views.en: A consistent thread: Intel must rebuild a customer-first, accountable engineering culture, move faster, and lead through AI-driven semiconductor innovation—whether via culture, strategy, or technology bets.
views.zh: 始终：连贯主线不变——英特尔必须重建客户至上、有担当的工程文化，加快速度，并以AI驱动的半导体创新来引领——无论通过文化、战略还是技术押注。

views.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; products must be fast and familiar. Brand is for recruiting; invest in ROI, not perfection.
views.zh: 2024年：设计师应通过写代码建立共情并加速交付；产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。品牌服务于招聘与差异化，投入应聚焦ROI而非面面俱到。

views.en: Velocity over perfection stays constant. Both interviews emphasize shipping fast, decisive ownership, and avoiding rigid process.
views.zh: 从2024到2026年一以贯之：速度优先于完美，快速发布、果断决策、给予设计师自主权，避免僵化流程。

views.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon. Founders must articulate why design wins; brand storytelling attracts top talent and signals quality.
views.zh: 2026年：设计升级为战略武器。创始人必须讲清楚设计如何让公司获胜；品牌叙事成为吸引顶尖人才、传递质量信号的方式。

views.en: Hiring shifts from coding empathy to diverse archetypes and self-learners. Gut decisions beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
views.zh: 2026年：用人从“会写代码的共情者”转向多样角色与自学型实习生；在高速增长的公司里，直觉决策往往优于数据驱动，流程应适配问题而非套用模板。

views.en: Values generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill skill gaps over specialists.

people.bioZh: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz 是一位智利设计师兼程序员,2018 年与 Cristóbal Valenzuela、Anastasis Germanidis 共同创办生成式 AI 公司 Runway,并担任首席设计官。他专注于将机器学习研究转化为直观易用的创作工具,主导塑造了 Runway 的 Gen 系列视频生成产品。

episodes.tEn: Building AI Products: Carving vs. Building

people.tiEn: Product & Design Lead, Google AI Studio
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 产品与设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ammaar Reshi is a design leader and AI creator who leads Product and Design for Google AI Studio (Gemini's developer platform) at Google DeepMind, having previously served as Head of Design at the AI voice company ElevenLabs. He is known for AI creative experiments, including "Alice and Sparkle," one of the first AI-generated children's books.
people.bioZh: Ammaar Reshi 是一位设计负责人与 AI 创作者,目前在 Google DeepMind 领导 Google AI Studio(Gemini 的开发者平台)的产品与设计工作,此前曾任 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人。他以 AI 创意实验闻名,包括最早的 AI 生成童书之一《Alice and Sparkle》。

episodes.tEn: Designing with AI: Capturing Magic Without Burdening Users

people.tiEn: Product Designer; former Head of Design at Luma AI
people.tiZh: 产品设计师;前 Luma AI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Tuhin Kumar is a product designer who has led design at Apple, Airbnb, Facebook, and generative-AI video/3D company Luma AI, where he served as Head of Design. In early 2026 he announced he had left Luma AI and is taking a break before deciding on his next role.
people.bioZh: 图欣·库马尔是一位产品设计师,曾在 Apple、Airbnb、Facebook 以及生成式 AI 视频/3D 公司 Luma AI 主导设计工作,在 Luma AI 担任设计负责人。2026 年初他宣布已从 Luma AI 离职,正处于休整期,尚未确定下一份工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing for Generative AI: From 0 to 1 with Luma AI's Head of Design

people.tiZh: Granola 联合创始人兼设计师
people.bioEn: Sam Stephenson is a British product designer and the co-founder of Granola, an AI notepad for meetings that reached a reported $1.5B valuation in 2026. A designer-turned-founder based in London, he leads the product's design-first philosophy of building calm, everyday software for the AI era.
people.bioZh: Sam Stephenson 是一位英国产品设计师,也是 AI 会议笔记应用 Granola 的联合创始人;该产品在 2026 年据报道达到 15 亿美元估值。他是一位从设计师转型的创始人,常驻伦敦,主导产品「设计优先」的理念,为 AI 时代打造平静、日常可用的软件。

episodes.tEn: Inventing the Future of AI-Assisted Work

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Claude (Anthropic); now Head of Design at Cursor
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 设计负责人;现任 Cursor 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Jenny Wen led design for Claude at Anthropic, where she drove the Claude.ai redesign and Claude Cowork; previously she was Director of Design at Figma leading the FigJam and Slides teams, and earlier a designer at Dropbox, Square, and Shopify. In July 2026 she announced she was leaving Anthropic to become Head of Design at Cursor.
people.bioZh: Jenny Wen 曾在 Anthropic 领导 Claude 的设计工作,主导了 Claude.ai 改版与 Claude Cowork;此前她是 Figma 设计总监,带领 FigJam 与 Slides 团队,更早在 Dropbox、Square 和 Shopify 担任设计师。2026 年 7 月,她宣布离开 Anthropic,出任 Cursor 设计负责人。

episodes.tEn: AI and Design: Three Designer Archetypes for the AI Era
How AI is Reshaping the Design Process

views.en: The traditional design process of research, diverge, converge is dead; designers must ship early and iterate to build trust.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为传统设计流程（研究、发散、收敛）已死，设计师必须尽早交付并快速迭代来建立信任。

views.en: Designers shift from handing off mocks to helping engineers execute; AI improves taste, but humans decide what matters.
views.zh: 从 2026 年 3 月到 5 月，他持续强调设计师要从交付稿子转向协助工程师落地；AI 会提升品味，但关键取舍仍由人类决定。

views.en: Designers split into three archetypes—block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; hire new grads without old process baggage.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出设计师分为三种原型：块状通才、深 T 专家和‘开挂新人’；应招聘不受旧流程束缚的新人。

views.en: North stars are now 3–6 months out, not years; speed is not an automatic improvement, and 'everyone uses it' is not a design argument.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为北极星目标已缩短到 3–6 个月而非数年；速度本身不是改进，‘大家都在用’也不能成为设计理由。

views.en: Wait six months before adopting new AI tools; put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他建议新技术先观望 6 个月再采用，要把工作和用户放在中心，而不是追逐 AI 炒作周期。

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University; Co-founder & Chief Scientist at Kumo.ai
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学教授;Kumo.ai 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jure Leskovec is a Slovenian-American computer scientist and professor of computer science at Stanford University, and co-founder and chief scientist of the graph machine-learning startup Kumo.ai. A pioneer of graph neural networks and relational deep learning, he previously served as chief scientist at Pinterest and leads work toward an AI Virtual Cell.
people.bioZh: 尤雷·莱斯科韦茨是斯洛文尼亚裔美国计算机科学家、斯坦福大学计算机科学教授,同时是图机器学习创业公司 Kumo.ai 的联合创始人兼首席科学家。他是图神经网络与关系型深度学习的先驱,曾任 Pinterest 首席科学家,目前主导「AI 虚拟细胞」相关研究。

episodes.tEn: Relational Foundation Model and AI Virtual Cell

people.tiEn: Associate Professor of Computer Science, Stanford University; Co-founder & CEO of Inception Labs
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授;Inception Labs 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Stefano Ermon is an associate professor of computer science at Stanford University, where his research spans generative models, diffusion, and machine learning for sustainability. In 2024 he co-founded Inception Labs, where he serves as CEO building diffusion-based large language models such as Mercury.
people.bioZh: Stefano Ermon 是斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授,研究领域涵盖生成模型、扩散模型以及面向可持续发展的机器学习。他于 2024 年联合创办 Inception Labs 并担任 CEO,开发 Mercury 等基于扩散的大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Diffusion LLMs: Faster, Cheaper, and Scaling Better Than Autoregressive Models

people.tiEn: LLM Research Engineer, author and educator
people.tiZh: 大语言模型研究工程师、作家与教育者
people.bioEn: Sebastian Raschka is a German-born LLM research engineer, educator and best-selling author of books including "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)" and "Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn." A former staff/senior engineer at Lightning AI and statistics professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, he writes the widely read "Ahead of AI" newsletter and is highly active on X (@rasbt).
people.bioZh: Sebastian Raschka 是出生于德国的大语言模型研究工程师、教育者和畅销书作家,著有《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》《Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn》等书。他曾任 Lightning AI 高级 / 员工工程师及威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校统计学教授,撰写广受欢迎的「Ahead of AI」通讯,并在 X(@rasbt)上非常活跃。

episodes.tEn: LLMs in 2026: Reasoning, Tool Use, and Post-Training Focus

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, Reflection AI
people.tiZh: Reflection AI 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Aakanksha Chowdhery is a member of technical staff at Reflection AI working on agentic AI and reinforcement learning for autonomous coding, and an adjunct professor at Stanford. She previously led pre-training work at Google, serving as lead author of the 540B-parameter PaLM model and a lead contributor to Gemini pre-training.
people.bioZh: Aakanksha Chowdhery 是 Reflection AI 的技术团队成员,研究智能体 AI 与用于自主编程的强化学习,同时担任斯坦福大学兼职教授。她此前在谷歌主导预训练工作,是 540B 参数 PaLM 模型的第一作者,也是 Gemini 预训练的核心贡献者。

episodes.tEn: Rethinking Pre-training for Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Yutori 联合创始人兼联合 CEO
people.bioEn: Devi Parikh is co-founder and co-CEO of Yutori, a startup building AI web agents. She was previously a Senior Director in Generative AI at Meta (until March 2024) and an associate professor at Georgia Tech, and is known for pioneering Visual Question Answering (VQA).
people.bioZh: Devi Parikh 是 AI 网页智能体创业公司 Yutori 的联合创始人兼联合 CEO。她此前担任 Meta 生成式 AI 部门高级总监(至 2024 年 3 月),并曾任佐治亚理工学院副教授,以开创视觉问答(VQA)研究而知名。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Web Interaction: AI Agents and Browser Automation

people.tiZh: Flexion Robotics 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Nikita Rudin is the co-founder and CEO of Flexion Robotics, a Zurich-based startup building the general-purpose intelligence stack ("brain") for humanoid robots. He earned a PhD in deep reinforcement learning for robotics at ETH Zurich's Robotic Systems Lab—where he created the widely used legged_gym and rsl_rl frameworks and trained the ANYmal quadruped via massively parallel RL—and previously worked as a research scientist at NVIDIA on Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab.
people.bioZh: Nikita Rudin 是 Flexion Robotics 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司位于苏黎世,致力于为人形机器人打造通用的智能栈(即机器人的「大脑」)。他在苏黎世联邦理工学院(ETH Zurich)机器人系统实验室获得机器人深度强化学习博士学位,期间开发了被广泛使用的 legged_gym 和 rsl_rl 框架,并用大规模并行强化学习训练四足机器人 ANYmal;此前他曾在 NVIDIA 担任研究科学家,参与 Isaac Gym 与 Isaac Lab 的研发。

episodes.tEn: The Gap Between Robotics Demos and Real-World Value

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley; Co-founder & CTO, Scaled Cognition
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授;Scaled Cognition 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Dan Klein is a professor of computer science at UC Berkeley, where he leads the Berkeley NLP Group within the BAIR lab, and has been a leading natural language processing researcher for two decades. He co-founded Scaled Cognition, serving as CTO, to build reliable agentic AI models.
people.bioZh: Dan Klein 是加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授,在 BAIR 实验室领导 Berkeley NLP Group,二十年来一直是自然语言处理领域的领军研究者。他联合创办了 Scaled Cognition 并担任 CTO,致力于打造可靠的智能体 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Designed to Sound Right, Not to Know What's Right
episodes.podEn: The AI Why with Liam Lawson

episodes.tEn: AI's Plausibility Problem: From Exponential Hype to Diminishing Returns

views.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; they optimize for fluent output, not factual accuracy.
views.zh: 大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎：它们优化流畅输出，而非事实准确性。

views.en: Reliability lags behind other facets of AI; it must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks.
views.zh: 可靠性落后于AI其他能力，必须被架构进系统，而非通过事后检查来补救。

views.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits demand new techniques like reasoning and search.
views.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇回报递减，数据墙与算力上限要求新的技术，如推理与搜索。

views.en: Post-training alignment like RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
views.zh: 后训练对齐（如RLHF）在奖励信号偏离真相时，可能激励谄媚与欺骗，而非仅产生错误。

people.tiZh: Edison Scientific(及 FutureHouse)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Samuel G. Rodriques is a physicist and bioengineer who earned his PhD in physics from MIT and co-founded the San Francisco research lab FutureHouse in 2023 to build an "AI Scientist" for accelerating biomedical discovery. He is co-founder and CEO of Edison Scientific, the for-profit spinout behind the Kosmos AI scientist, and was named to the 2025 TIME100 AI.
people.bioZh: Samuel G. Rodriques 是一位物理学家兼生物工程师,在 MIT 取得物理学博士学位,并于 2023 年联合创办旧金山研究实验室 FutureHouse,致力于打造能加速生物医学发现的「AI 科学家」。他是从中拆分出的营利性公司 Edison Scientific 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司推出了 AI 科学家 Kosmos,他本人入选 2025 年 TIME100 AI 榜单。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientist: The Future of Drug Discovery

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Axiom (AI for formal mathematical reasoning)
people.tiZh: Axiom 创始人兼 CEO（面向形式化数学推理的 AI）
people.bioEn: Carina Letong Hong is the founder and CEO of Axiom, an AI startup building an "AI mathematician" that generates and formally verifies mathematical proofs. A former Stanford mathematics PhD student and Rhodes Scholar with a math-olympiad and MIT background, she raised $64M in seed funding (2025) and later a ~$200M round valuing Axiom at about $1.6B.
people.bioZh: 洪乐潼是 AI 创业公司 Axiom 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司致力于打造能生成并形式化验证数学证明的「AI 数学家」。她拥有数学奥赛与 MIT 背景,曾是斯坦福数学博士生和罗德学者;公司先后完成 6400 万美元种子轮融资(2025 年)及约 2 亿美元后续融资,估值约 16 亿美元。

episodes.tEn: Verified AI: Scaling Brilliance Through Formal Verification
Axiom Math: Building a Self-Improving Reasoning Engine with AI Mathematician

views.en: Axiom builds self-improving reasoning engine; informal scaling to math AI is not viable; formal verification essential.
views.zh: 2026年初，提出构建自改进推理引擎，认为非正式Scaling（规模扩张）数学AI不可行，形式验证必不可少。

views.en: Formal verification scales brilliance, delivering performance gains over informal methods; needed for all AI-generated code.
views.zh: 2026年中，形式验证能扩展才华，比非正式方法带来性能增益；应适用于所有AI生成代码。

views.en: Skeptical of informal-only scaling; insists formal methods and human taste remain crucial.
views.zh: 始终对纯非正式Scaling（规模扩张）持怀疑，强调形式方法与人类品味仍至关重要。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Platform (API) at OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI 平台(API)产品负责人
people.bioEn: Olivier Godement is Head of Product for OpenAI's developer platform (API), which he has led since May 2023, overseeing products such as the Responses API and Agents SDK. A French product leader, he previously spent over eight years at Stripe and studied at Sciences Po and ESSEC.
people.bioZh: Olivier Godement 自 2023 年 5 月起担任 OpenAI 开发者平台(API)产品负责人,主导 Responses API、Agents SDK 等面向开发者的产品。他是法国籍产品负责人,加入 OpenAI 前曾在 Stripe 工作 8 年以上,毕业于巴黎政治学院与 ESSEC 商学院。

episodes.tEn: 2025: The Year of Enterprise Coding

people.tiEn: Head of Research Product Management, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究产品管理负责人
people.bioEn: Dianne Na Penn is Head of Research Product Management at Anthropic, where she joined as the company's first technical product manager and leads bringing Claude models and Anthropic's research to users and developers across launches such as Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.5. She previously led product for natural-language modeling at Amazon's Alexa AI.
people.bioZh: Dianne Na Penn 是 Anthropic 的研究产品管理负责人,作为公司第一位技术产品经理加入,主导将 Claude 模型与 Anthropic 的研究成果带给用户和开发者,并参与了 Sonnet 4.5、Haiku 4.5、Opus 4.5 等模型的发布。此前她在亚马逊 Alexa AI 负责自然语言建模的产品工作。

episodes.tEn: From Underdog to Leader: Diane Penn on Anthropic's Rise and Product Strategy
Opus 4.5: Deep Dive into Anthropic's Research and Product Strategy

views.en: Safety and alignment improve model intelligence, not just prevent harm; they enable pushback and independent thinking.
views.zh: 安全与对齐不止防止危害,更能提升模型智能——它让模型学会反驳与独立思考,这一立场贯穿始终。

views.en: From raw intelligence leap to product differentiation: by 2026, coding and Claude Code drive adoption, not just benchmark gains.
views.zh: 从2025年强调Opus 4.5的智力跃升,到2026年转向编程与Claude Code驱动采用——思考重心从模型能力转向产品落地。

views.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product management; managers must write evals like tests and stay hands-on.
views.zh: 2026年,他认为评估(Evals)取代传统PRD成为产品管理核心,管理者要像写测试一样写评估并保持亲手实践。

people.tiEn: AI researcher; former head of OpenAI's Sora, co-inventor of Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
people.tiZh: AI 研究员;OpenAI Sora 前负责人,扩散 Transformer(DiT)共同发明者
people.bioEn: Bill (William) Peebles led OpenAI's Sora video-generation team, which he built from research to product before departing OpenAI in April 2026 as the Sora app was wound down. He earned his PhD at UC Berkeley (advised by Alexei Efros) and co-invented the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with Saining Xie, the architecture underpinning modern text-to-video models.
people.bioZh: Bill(William)Peebles 曾领导 OpenAI 的 Sora 视频生成团队,将其从研究推进到产品,并在 2026 年 4 月 Sora 应用被关停之际离开 OpenAI。他在加州大学伯克利分校获得博士学位(导师为 Alexei Efros),并与谢赛宁(Saining Xie)共同发明了扩散 Transformer(DiT)——支撑现代文本生成视频模型的核心架构。

episodes.tEn: Sora: The AI Video Revolution and Social Experience

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO of Sierra; Chairman of the Board, OpenAI
people.tiZh: Sierra 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenAI 董事会主席
people.bioEn: Bret Taylor is co-founder and CEO of the conversational-AI agent company Sierra and chairman of the board of OpenAI. He previously served as co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook, and earlier led the team that co-created Google Maps.
people.bioZh: Bret Taylor 是对话式 AI 智能体公司 Sierra 的联合创始人兼 CEO，同时担任 OpenAI 董事会主席。他此前曾任 Salesforce 联席 CEO 和 Facebook 首席技术官,更早时还领导团队共同创造了 Google 地图。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents: The New Internet Wave

people.tiEn: Head of Engineering, OpenAI API Platform
people.tiZh: OpenAI API 平台工程负责人
people.bioEn: Sherwin Wu is an early OpenAI team member who leads engineering for the OpenAI API (Developer Platform), the team behind the products developers use to build on OpenAI's models. Before OpenAI he spent 5+ years on Opendoor's pricing team and earlier worked at Quora, after earning a computer science degree from MIT.
people.bioZh: 吴谢文是 OpenAI 的早期成员,负责 OpenAI API(开发者平台)的工程团队,该团队打造了供开发者基于 OpenAI 模型进行构建的产品。加入 OpenAI 之前,他在 Opendoor 的定价团队工作了 5 年多,更早曾任职于 Quora,拥有麻省理工学院(MIT)计算机科学学位。

episodes.tEn: 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex, 100% PRs reviewed by AI

people.tiZh: Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)联合创始人兼普通合伙人
people.bioEn: Marc Andreessen is an American entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-authored the Mosaic web browser and co-founded Netscape. He is co-founder and general partner of the Silicon Valley venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which he started with Ben Horowitz in 2009.
people.bioZh: 马克·安德森是美国企业家与风险投资人,曾参与开发 Mosaic 浏览器并联合创办网景(Netscape)公司。他是硅谷风险投资机构 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)的联合创始人兼普通合伙人,该公司由他与本·霍洛维茨于 2009 年共同创立。

episodes.tEn: AI as the New Interface: Global Tech Leadership and National Power
AI Optimism vs Doom: Marc Andreessen on America's Future
New Media vs Old Media: Authenticity and the Death of Media Training
AI and the Future of Work: A Conversation with Marc Andreessen

views.en: AI as alchemy; with population decline, humans become premium. Tasks vanish, jobs persist; super-empowered individuals rise. AGI is not a singular event.
views.zh: 2026年1月：AI是炼金术；人口下降使人类变稀缺。任务消失、职业留存，超级个体崛起；AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件。

views.en: Authenticity and new media win; founders become their own brands, old media's 'don't be interesting' rule fails. Fights build brands.
views.zh: 2026年6月：真实性与新媒体取胜；创始人成为自有品牌，旧媒体‘别有趣’的规矩失效。吵架也能建立品牌。

views.en: AI is world-class teacher and outperforms doctors; self-driving works; robotics arrives in a decade. Pessimism is intellectual bias; regulation holds back US golden geese.
views.zh: 2026年7月2日：AI是世界级教师，且胜过医生；自动驾驶已成熟，机器人十年内到来。悲观是知识分子偏见，监管拖累美国金鹅。

views.en: AI models carry cultural values and become geopolitical weapons; deterrence hinges on innovation pace. Startups must go global early; open-source is double-edged.
views.zh: 2026年7月3日：AI模型承载文化价值，成为地缘政治武器；威慑取决于创新速度。初创企业需尽早国际化，开源是双刃剑。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 增长负责人
people.bioEn: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, which he joined by cold-emailing the leadership before any growth role existed; on his watch the product scaled from roughly $1B to over $19B in ARR. He previously led growth product teams at Mercury and MasterClass and was a startup founder before that.
people.bioZh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic(Claude 背后的 AI 公司)的增长负责人,他在公司尚未设立增长岗位时靠主动发送邮件毛遂自荐而加入,任内产品的年化经常性收入(ARR)从约 10 亿美元跃升至逾 190 亿美元。此前他曾在 Mercury 和 MasterClass 带领增长产品团队,更早还是一名创业公司创始人。

episodes.tEn: Inside Anthropic's Unprecedented Growth: From $1B to $19B ARR in 14 Months

people.tiZh: Applied Intuition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Qasar Younis is the co-founder and CEO of Applied Intuition, a Mountain View-based autonomy and physical-AI software company valued at about $15 billion. Born on a farm in Pakistan, he previously started his career as an engineer at General Motors and Bosch, co-founded Talkbin (acquired by Google), and served as COO of Y Combinator from 2015 to 2017.
people.bioZh: 卡萨尔·尤尼斯是 Applied Intuition 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家位于山景城的自动驾驶与物理 AI 软件公司估值约为 150 亿美元。他出生于巴基斯坦的一个农场,职业生涯始于通用汽车和博世的工程师岗位,后联合创办了 Talkbin(被谷歌收购),并于 2015 至 2017 年间担任 Y Combinator 的首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Autonomous Vehicles: From Tesla to Waymo and Beyond
The AI CEO Nobody Knows: Building the Future of Physical AI

views.en: AI will create abundance and reduce suffering; physical AI will transform farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years, but fear stems from misunderstanding.
views.zh: 2026年3月：AI将带来丰裕、减少苦难；物理AI将在5-10年内改变农业、矿业和建筑业，恐惧源于误解。

views.en: Autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
views.zh: 2026年3月：自动驾驶已比人类更安全；创始人应专注产品与客户，而非宣传。

views.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles and environments.
views.zh: 2026年6月：自动驾驶核心价值是挽救生命；Transformer（Transformer）支持跨车辆与环境的通用物理AI模型。

views.en: Horizontal platforms beat vertical integration for self-driving; diverse vertical data improves physical AI faster; hardest is diffusion into existing machines.
views.zh: 2026年6月：自动驾驶中横向平台优于垂直整合；多垂直领域数据加速物理AI；最难的是融入现有设备。

views.en: AI is a timely solution for labor shortages and aging populations; Chinese companies differ from Western ones as state extensions.
views.zh: 始终：AI是应对劳动力短缺与老龄化的及时方案；中国公司是国家的延伸，与西方公司不同。

people.tiEn: Independent software developer and AI blogger (simonwillison.net); creator of Datasette and the LLM CLI
people.tiZh: 独立软件开发者与 AI 博主(simonwillison.net);Datasette 与 LLM 命令行工具的作者
people.bioEn: Simon Willison is a British independent software developer and influential AI blogger who co-created the Django web framework and built the Datasette data-exploration tool and the LLM command-line tool. He coined the term "prompt injection" in 2022 and, more recently, "lethal trifecta" (2025) and "agentic engineering" (2026); he has served on the Python Software Foundation board since 2022.
people.bioZh: Simon Willison 是一位英国独立软件开发者与颇具影响力的 AI 博主,他是 Django Web 框架的共同作者,并开发了 Datasette 数据探索工具与 LLM 命令行工具。他在 2022 年提出了「提示词注入(prompt injection)」一词,近来又提出「致命三要素(lethal trifecta)」(2025)与「智能体工程(agentic engineering)」(2026);自 2022 年起担任 Python 软件基金会理事。

episodes.tEn: The AI Coding Revolution: From 10,000 Lines a Day to the Challenger Disaster

people.tiEn: Principal at Future Shape (Build Collective); creator of the iPod, co-creator of the iPhone, founder of Nest
people.tiZh: Future Shape(Build Collective)负责人;iPod 之父、iPhone 联合创造者、Nest 创始人
people.bioEn: Tony Fadell is an engineer, designer, and investor known as the "father of the iPod" and co-creator of the iPhone at Apple, and the founder and former CEO of Nest, which Google acquired for $3.2 billion in 2014. He is a former member of the General Magic team, principal at his investment and advisory firm Future Shape (Build Collective), and author of the New York Times bestseller "Build".
people.bioZh: 托尼·法德尔是一位工程师、设计师与投资人,被称为「iPod 之父」,在苹果参与联合创造了 iPhone,并创立 Nest 且曾任其 CEO;2014 年 Nest 被谷歌以 32 亿美元收购。他曾是 General Magic 团队成员,如今是投资与顾问机构 Future Shape(Build Collective)的负责人,也是《纽约时报》畅销书《Build》的作者。

episodes.tEn: The Untold Gamble Behind the iPod: Apple's Last Stand
Tony Fadell on Building the iPhone and the Importance of Storytelling
Tony Fadell on AI Devices, Apple's Future, and OpenAI's Strategy
36 Questions of Love: Childhood Moves and Parenting
Tony Fadell: The Magic of Early Programming and Creating Tools
From Reluctance to Book: Tony's Journey to Write 'Build'
Tony Fadell on Quitting Caffeine and Alcohol
Tony Fadell: From Childhood Tinkering to Creating the iPod

views.en: Good products solve one urgent pain (iPod), not everything; first versions need opinion-based decisions and storytelling.
views.zh: 好产品解决一个紧迫痛点(iPod),而非所有问题;第一版需要基于观点的决策和讲故事。

views.en: Leaders should be coaches, embrace failure and breaks; self-managed small teams outperform.
views.zh: 领导者应是教练,拥抱失败与停顿;自我管理的小团队表现更佳。

views.en: AI needs sensor context and companion devices; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models are more reliable.
views.zh: AI需要传感器上下文和配套设备;大语言模型会幻觉,特定上下文模型更可靠。

views.en: Technology must be introduced gradually and timed well; being too early (General Magic) is a common failure.
views.zh: 技术必须渐进引入并把握时机;太超前(General Magic)是常见失败。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO of ChatPRD; host of the "How I AI" podcast
people.tiZh: ChatPRD 创始人兼 CEO;「How I AI」播客主持人
people.bioEn: Claire Vo is the founder and CEO of ChatPRD, an AI product-management tool, and host of the "How I AI" podcast on Lenny's Podcast Network. A three-time chief product/technology officer (LaunchDarkly, Color Health, Optimizely) and repeat founder and engineer, she is known for running ChatPRD as an AI-native company operated with a fleet of AI agents.
people.bioZh: Claire Vo 是 AI 产品管理工具 ChatPRD 的创始人兼 CEO,也是 Lenny 播客网络旗下「How I AI」播客的主持人。她曾三度担任首席产品/技术官(LaunchDarkly、Color Health、Optimizely),是连续创业者兼工程师,以用一支 AI 智能体「团队」把 ChatPRD 打造成 AI 原生公司而广为人知。

episodes.tEn: From Skeptic to Power User: Claire Vo on OpenClaw

people.tiEn: Independent technology analyst; former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
people.tiZh: 独立科技分析师;前 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人
people.bioEn: Benedict Evans is a British independent technology analyst and former partner at Andreessen Horowitz, known for his weekly newsletter (175,000+ subscribers) and his widely followed annual presentations on tech and AI trends. Before going independent, he spent years as a16z's in-house analyst tracking major platform shifts across mobile, media and technology.
people.bioZh: Benedict Evans 是英国独立科技分析师,曾任 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人,以其拥有 17.5 万 + 订阅者的每周简报,以及广受关注的年度科技与 AI 趋势演示而闻名。转为独立分析师之前,他在 a16z 担任内部分析师多年,长期追踪移动、媒体与科技领域的重大平台变革。

episodes.tEn: AI Models Commoditization and Public Market Test
Agentic Coding: From Useful to Game-Changing
AI Is as Big as the Internet or Mobile

views.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but model firms may lack pricing power; value shifts to applications.
views.zh: 2026年5月底，他强调AI堪比互联网或移动互联网，但模型公司可能缺乏定价权，价值会转移到应用层。

views.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models become commodity infrastructure; value moves up the stack.
views.zh: 2026年6月初，他表示智能体式编程是大语言模型第一个清晰的产品市场契合点，基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值上移到应用层。

views.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; coding is the only clear PMF; average answers need product wrapping.
views.zh: 2026年6月下旬，他进一步确认模型因没有网络效应而商品化，编程至今仍是唯一清晰的产品市场契合点，大模型只能给出平均答案，需要产品包装。

people.tiZh: Every 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Dan Shipper is the co-founder and CEO of Every, an applied AI lab and media company that publishes a daily AI newsletter and ships AI software products. He writes the weekly column Chain of Thought and hosts the AI & I podcast about how people use AI, and previously co-founded Firefly, which he sold to Pegasystems in 2014.
people.bioZh: 丹·希珀是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这是一家「应用 AI 实验室」兼媒体公司,既发布每日 AI 通讯,也开发多款 AI 软件产品。他撰写每周专栏 Chain of Thought,主持探讨人们如何使用 AI 的播客 AI & I;此前曾联合创办 Firefly,并于 2014 年将其出售给 Pegasystems。

episodes.tEn: AI Job Apocalypse Is a Lie: Dan Shipper’s Bold Predictions for Work in 2025

people.tiZh: OpenAI 战略前瞻（Strategic Futures）负责人
people.bioEn: Dean Woodley Ball is an AI policy expert who joined OpenAI in July 2026 to lead its new Strategic Futures team shaping frontier AI policy, having previously served as senior policy advisor at the White House OSTP where he was primary author of America's AI Action Plan. He authors the Hyperdimensional Substack and was a senior fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation.
people.bioZh: Dean Woodley Ball 是 AI 政策专家，于 2026 年 7 月加入 OpenAI，领导新设的 Strategic Futures 团队以塑造前沿 AI 政策；此前他在白宫科技政策办公室（OSTP）任高级政策顾问，是美国《AI 行动计划》的主要执笔人。他运营 Hyperdimensional Substack，曾任美国创新基金会（FAI）高级研究员。

episodes.tEn: Dean Ball on Joining OpenAI, AI Policy, and Recursive Self-Improvement

people.tiZh: METR 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Beth Barnes is the founder and CEO of METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research), a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models' capabilities on long-horizon agentic tasks; she previously worked on AI alignment at OpenAI and DeepMind and started the org as ARC Evals before it became independent. She was named to TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024.
people.bioZh: Beth Barnes 是 METR(模型评估与威胁研究)的创始人兼 CEO,这家非营利机构专门评估前沿 AI 模型在长周期智能体任务上的能力;此前她曾在 OpenAI 和 DeepMind 从事 AI 对齐研究,并以 ARC Evals 的名义创立该机构,后其独立运营。她入选了 2024 年《时代》周刊「AI 领域百大影响力人物」。

episodes.tEn: Evaluating AI Capabilities and Risks: A Conversation with Beth and David

people.tiZh: Cosine(Genie)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alistair Pullen is the co-founder and CEO of Cosine, a London-based, Y Combinator-backed AI startup that built Genie, an autonomous software-engineering model that in 2024 set a then-record score on the SWE-bench benchmark. Cosine is now developing Lumen Sovereign, positioned as Britain's first fully sovereign frontier AI model for defense and regulated sectors.
people.bioZh: Alistair Pullen 是 Cosine 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家总部位于伦敦、由 Y Combinator 支持的 AI 创业公司打造了自主软件工程模型 Genie,该模型于 2024 年在 SWE-bench 基准测试上创下当时的最高纪录。Cosine 目前正在研发 Lumen Sovereign,定位为面向国防与受监管行业的英国首个完全主权前沿 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Sovereign AI: Building the UK's First LLM on a Startup Budget

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT (VP of Product), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 负责人(产品副总裁)
people.bioEn: Nick Turley is the Head of ChatGPT and VP of Product at OpenAI, where he joined in 2022 and helped ship and scale ChatGPT into one of the fastest-growing products in history, reaching roughly 800 million weekly users. He previously held product leadership roles at Instacart and Dropbox.
people.bioZh: Nick Turley 是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人兼产品副总裁,2022 年加入公司,参与打造并规模化 ChatGPT,使其成为史上增长最快的产品之一,周活跃用户约 8 亿。他此前曾在 Instacart 和 Dropbox 担任产品管理负责人。

episodes.tEn: From Free Demo to Super Assistant: OpenAI's Journey

people.tiZh: Meta 创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Mark Zuckerberg is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms, which he launched as Facebook in 2004. With his wife Priscilla Chan he runs the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub aims to use AI to help cure, prevent or manage all disease by the end of the century.
people.bioZh: 马克·扎克伯格是 Meta Platforms 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO,该公司于 2004 年以 Facebook 之名创立。他与妻子 Priscilla Chan 共同运营 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative,旗下 Biohub 致力于用 AI 在本世纪末前治愈、预防或管理所有疾病。

episodes.tEn: Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Reeves on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Open source is safer than closed source; distributing AI prevents power concentration and enables broad scrutiny.
views.zh: 2023到2026年，他始终坚持开源比闭源更安全：分布式AI能防止权力集中，并让更多人参与审查与加固。

views.en: AI vision shifted from many specialized agents to personal superintelligence — empowering individuals, not a single centralized AI.
views.zh: 从2023年的多个专用智能体，到2025年他更强调个人超级智能：AI应赋能每个人，而非一个集中的超级智能。

views.en: Scaling concerns expanded from compute/energy bottlenecks to using AI as an engineering tool for biology, with world models and interpretability.
views.zh: 2024年他关注Scaling（规模扩张）的算力与能源瓶颈；到2026年，转向用AI把生物学变成工程学科，强调世界模型和可解释性。

views.en: The next computing platform evolved from AR glasses to AI-native glasses; personal AI plus hardware fusion becomes the main path.
views.zh: 从2025年谈全息眼镜，到2026年明确眼镜是下一代计算平台：AI与硬件深度融合，个人AI成为核心体验。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: By 2026, he rejects benchmark scores as true eval, insisting private evals and unique user value define frontier success.
views.zh: 2026 年，他不再把基准分数当作真正的评测，而是强调私有评测与用户独特价值才是前沿模型成败的关键。

views.en: In June 2026, he evolves from AI platform strategy to 'AI as future of the firm,' making every enterprise a hill-climbing machine.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他从平台战略深化为“AI 即公司的未来”，让每家企业都成为爬山机器，以复利积累 token 资本。

views.en: He shifts pricing view from per-user artifact to outcome/consumption pricing, while urging token efficiency for non-frontier problems.
views.zh: 同一时期，他批评按用户定价只是预算确定性的产物，看好按消费/结果定价，并呼吁在非前沿问题上避免浪费前沿模型以提升 token 效率。

views.en: He elevates security and containment alongside tacit knowledge leakage as central agent-deployment risks, not just alignment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把治理重点从一般性对齐转向安全、遏制、可观测性，特别警惕企业隐性知识因 AI 训练而外泄。

views.en: He extends sovereign AI from enterprise firewalls to country-level comparative advantage, projecting 10% global GDP compounding.
views.zh: 同期，他把“主权 AI”从筑防火墙变成赋能各国爬山，让每个国家发挥比较优势，甚至推动全球 GDP 以 10% 复利增长。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Inference speed determines AI adoption; slow AI has no market. Wafer-scale architecture enables radically faster and cheaper tokens.
views.zh: 2026年5月，他强调推理速度决定AI落地，慢的AI没有市场；晶圆级架构让 token 更快更便宜。

views.en: Frontier labs are critical for hardware alignment. GPU inference is slow per user; China's edge is power infrastructure, not compute.
views.zh: 2026年5月，他指出前沿实验室对硬件对齐至关重要；GPU推理单用户速度慢，中国优势在电力基础设施而非算力。

views.en: CUDA matters less in inference; two of three leading frontier models no longer use it. Data centers, not chips, constrain growth.
views.zh: 2026年5月，他认为CUDA在推理中重要性下降，三大前沿模型有两个不再用它；制约增长的是数据中心而非芯片。

views.en: AI demand exceeds forecasts; 20x inference speed is critical. AI can transform healthcare and education; doomers ignore the positive ledger.
views.zh: 2026年7月，AI需求超预期，20倍推理速度是关键；AI能变革医疗和教育，末日论者忽视正面账本。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models

views.en: Bad benchmarks mislead AI progress; human evals and RL environments are the future, with diverse frontier models.
views.zh: 2025年他指出，糟糕的基准会误导AI进展；人类评估和强化学习环境才是未来，前沿模型应多元发展。

views.en: In medicine, AI needs human judgment, safety over accuracy, and grounding via retrieval to avoid hallucinations and omission.
views.zh: 2026年在医疗领域，他强调AI离不开人类判断，安全优先于准确，并需通过检索增强生成来避免幻觉和遗漏。

views.en: A consistent emphasis on human oversight and quality evaluation, evolving from model diversity to applied safety and judgment.
views.zh: 始终强调人类监督与质量评估，从2025年的模型多元论深化到2026年的医疗安全与判断力应用。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AGI will transform civilization, but current LLMs merely index human knowledge and cannot handle the physical world.
views.zh: 2025年，我认为AGI将改变文明，但现有大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

views.en: AI safety fears are overstated; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not destroy us.
views.zh: 从2025年到2026年，我始终认为AI安全担忧被夸大——智能系统会对生命产生好奇并保护它，而非毁灭人类。

views.en: True AGI requires embodied physical robots with human-level hardware, not just software behind a screen.
views.zh: 2026年，我明确强调真正的AGI需要具身物理机器人，其硬件要达到人类水平，而不只是屏幕后的软件。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is no moat; open-source models will catch up, and closed-source companies won't profit.
views.zh: 2026年，我提出递归自我改进不是护城河，开源模型会迅速追上，闭源公司难以盈利。

views.en: Massive AI data-center capex is overdone; waiting five years gives 10x cheaper compute and risks a crash.
views.zh: 2026年，我警告AI数据中心的大规模投入过头了，等五年算力便宜十倍，当前投资面临崩盘风险。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人

people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)

people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Initially argued LLMs encode human behavior, enabling society simulations; real-world behavioral data and new statistical standards are needed.
views.zh: 最早（2026 年 6 月中旬）主张大语言模型能编码人类行为，可用来模拟社会；但需真实行为数据弥补“言行差”，并建立模拟有效性的统计标准。

views.en: Quickly expanded from simulating human societies to building real-world agentic systems, stressing defense-in-depth, incentives, and collusion risks.
views.zh: 随后（2026 年 6 月下旬）从模拟人类社会转向构建真实世界的智能体系统，强调纵深防御、激励设计和反合谋风险。

views.en: Persistent thread: collective/distributed intelligence over a single superintelligence—first societal simulators, then agentic economies.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：始终关注集体/分布式智能而非单一超级智能——从模拟人类集体行为，到最终设想要管理一个由专业智能体构成的智能体经济。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Initially prioritizes efficiency over scaling: liquid networks with closed-form solutions, automated architecture search, and device-native small models for edge.
views.zh: 最早（2026年7月4日）强调效率优先于Scaling：用闭式解的液态网络、自动化架构搜索，以及面向终端的设备原生小模型。

views.en: Challenges Transformer hegemony: attention suits large models, but gated convolutions and systematic search outperform hand-tuned experts on real tasks.
views.zh: 同期质疑Transformer霸权：注意力机制适合大规模模型，但门控卷积与系统性搜索在真实任务上优于专家手工设计。

views.en: Shifts from arguing proxy metrics mislead to emphasizing real deployment, hardware co-design, and learning paradigms beyond architecture.
views.zh: 从批评困惑度等代理指标，转向强调真实部署、硬件协同设计，以及超越架构的新学习范式。

views.en: Broadens to governance: adaptive regulation, open-weight customization, and regulating actions rather than capabilities align with small-model sovereignty.
views.zh: 到2026年7月17日，扩展到治理层面：主张适应性监管、开放权重定制，并强调监管行为而非能力，以小模型主权为核心。

people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, with narrow superintelligence in coding already here.
views.zh: 2026年6月，智能体式AI仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，编码领域的窄超级智能已出现。

views.en: Model now includes agent harness and tooling; Omni as one world model blurs video and world model boundaries.
views.zh: 2026年年中，模型已包含智能体支架与工具，Omni作为单一世界模型模糊了视频与世界模型的边界。

views.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, generating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
views.zh: 2026年7月，软件创建将基本被解决，由此带来千倍以上的机会，而非更少。

views.en: Deep code understanding remains vital despite AI tools; overwhelm comes from too much opportunity, not too much change.
views.zh: 2026年7月，尽管有AI工具，深度理解代码仍至关重要；疲惫感源于机会太多而非变化太快。

people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making batch size the key lever for latency/cost trade-off.
views.zh: 推理成本由内存带宽主导,batch size 成为权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

views.en: From inference-level memory bottlenecks to chip-level data movement costs, the analysis deepens from system to silicon.
views.zh: 从推理层面的内存瓶颈到芯片内部的数据移动成本,分析从系统层深化到硅片层。

views.en: Low precision yields superlinear efficiency gains due to quadratic scaling of area with bit width.
views.zh: 由于面积随位宽二次方缩放,低精度带来超线性的效率提升。

views.en: Memory bandwidth/data movement, not compute, is the dominant bottleneck across AI inference and chip design.
views.zh: 内存带宽/数据移动而非算力,是 AI 推理与芯片设计中的主导瓶颈。

episodes.tEn: How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market
Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

views.en: Language models now drive visual intelligence; video models need synthetic data, and the bottleneck is agentic/language capability, not vision architecture.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月,他认为视觉智能的进步来自语言模型,视频模型依赖合成数据,瓶颈是智能体与语言能力,而不是视觉架构。

views.en: Video-based world models require real-time interactive generation; language models as orchestrators will power video agents and generative interfaces.
views.zh: 同月,他强调世界模型需要实时交互式长程视频生成,语言模型作为编排者将驱动视频智能体与生成式界面。

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; agents now perform complex tasks at expert level, but junior misuse of AI stems from lack of domain expertise.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月中旬,他转向社会影响:AI 是通用目的技术,智能体已可完成专家级任务,但初级者因缺乏领域经验而误用 AI。

views.en: The real risk is losing the human talent pipeline; AI has a generic voice, so human taste and genuine points of view become key differentiators.
views.zh: 他进一步指出,最大风险是人类人才管道断裂;AI 声音千篇一律,人的品味与独特观点反而成为关键差异。

people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Initially, Patel frames AI scaling as a semiconductor supply-chain problem: EUV tools, memory bandwidth per wafer, and geopolitics decide compute growth.
views.zh: 早期（2026 年 3 月）他把 AI Scaling 主要看成半导体供应链问题：EUV 设备、每晶圆内存带宽与地缘政治决定算力增长。

views.en: His lens widens from physical bottlenecks to economics: inference will become one of the world's largest markets, surpassing oil, while memory bandwidth remains the key bottleneck.
views.zh: 从物理瓶颈转向经济结构——他认为推理将成为全球最大市场之一、超过石油，而内存带宽仍是核心瓶颈。

views.en: He stresses hardware-software co-design and neoclouds, arguing most recent AI performance gains come from the model layer, not hardware, and CUDA's moat is weakening.
views.zh: 他强调软硬件协同设计与 Neocloud，认为近三年 AI 性能提升主要来自模型层而非硬件，CUDA 护城河正在削弱。

views.en: By midsummer, he sees reasoning and agentic workflows driving memory and CPU demand, with power becoming a key constraint; copper beats co-packaged optics medium-term.
views.zh: 到年中，思维链推理与智能体式工作流推高内存和 CPU 需求，电力成为关键约束；中短期内铜缆优于共封装光学。

views.en: A consistent thread: memory bandwidth, not raw bits, is the true limit; AI progress is exponential (~60x/year cost improvement), so frontier compute remains scarce and valuable.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：真正的限制是内存带宽而非比特数；AI 进步接近指数级（每年成本改进约 60 倍），因此前沿算力始终稀缺且珍贵。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人

people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Initially: AI is not yet a new platform; we're still in mobile/web era. He champions 'Proven Better New' and copying as moral arbitrage.
views.zh: 最初他认为AI还不是新平台，仍处于移动与Web时代，并推崇‘成熟、更好、创新’框架，视复制为道德套利。

views.en: He shifts: consumer AI is uninvestable yet opportunity has never been greater; revolution likely in 2029, three orders of magnitude away.
views.zh: 随后他转向：消费级AI虽不可投资，但机会空前，革命可能在2029年，距离当下还有三个数量级。

views.en: By July he's more cautious: consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise/prosumer offer better near-term opportunities.
views.zh: 到了7月他更加谨慎：消费应用因分发问题不可投资，企业和专业市场近期机会更好。

views.en: Throughout, he insists most new ideas fail; start from proven, add small betterments, and test new ideas expecting failure.
views.zh: 他始终强调：大多数新想法会失败；从成熟处起步、做小改进，并以失败预期测试新想法。

episodes.tEn: Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers

views.en: In 2025, reasoning via chain of thought and RLHF unlocked GPT-4; pre-training plus RL is core, but scaling RL is harder.
views.zh: 2025年：思维链与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）解锁了GPT-4；预训练加强化学习是核心，但Scaling强化学习更难。

views.en: By 2026, scaling pre-training and RL improves but limits generalization; continual learning and self-correction are missing for AGI.
views.zh: 到2026年：Scaling预训练和强化学习虽有提升但泛化受限；持续学习与自我纠错是迈向AGI缺失的关键。

views.en: Later in 2026, transformers cannot enable continual learning; architecture, not scaling, becomes the bottleneck; RL is not ultimate.
views.zh: 2026年后期：Transformer无法支持持续学习；架构而非Scaling成为瓶颈；强化学习并非终极学习方式。

AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: In 2024, AI science should solve root-node problems at scale; harness hallucination with truth detectors for discovery.
views.zh: 2024年，主张AI科学应聚焦根节点级难题并依靠规模，同时用真值检测器驾驭幻觉来推动发现。

views.en: Always forced generalization beyond memorization; by 2026, verifiable domains plus post-training RL became the key path.
views.zh: 始终强调超越记忆、逼出泛化；到2026年，进一步明确可验证领域与后训练强化学习是突破人类知识的关键路径。

views.en: In 2026, large language models are a shortcut limited by human data; RL and search push beyond.
views.zh: 2026年，批评大语言模型只是捷径、受制于人类数据，主张用强化学习和搜索超越人类已有知识。

views.en: In 2026, interpretability is not essential for breakthroughs; correct uninterpretable proofs are acceptable.
views.zh: 2026年，明确可解释性对科学突破并非必需，正确但不可解释的证明可以接受。

views.en: Always: AI can yield insights beyond human knowledge in specific domains, from Go to biology.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：AI能在围棋、生物学等具体领域产生超越人类认知的洞见。

views.en: In 2025, he argues end-to-end neural nets plus world models, not hand-coded stacks, solve driving; scaling data and compute is key.
views.zh: 2025年，他认为端到端神经网络加世界模型而非手工代码栈能解决驾驶问题，关键在于扩张数据与算力。

views.en: He moves from touting interpretable end-to-end models to stressing infrastructure and data quality over algorithmic innovation for scaling.
views.zh: 他从2025年鼓吹可解释的端到端模型，转向2026年强调基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更利于规模化。

views.en: By 2026, safety means minimal-risk maneuvers as a third option; mass-market cars, not robotaxis, will lead scaled deployment.
views.zh: 到2026年，安全意味着最小风险操作作为第三选项；规模部署将由大众市场汽车而非机器人出租车引领。

views.en: Dismissed AGI as distant, narrow AI as pattern recognition. Centered on equity ownership, self-directed reading, and happiness as desirelessness.
views.zh: 2019-2020年间，他认为AGI（通用人工智能）遥不可及，狭义AI只是模式识别；核心围绕股权致富、自主阅读，以及把幸福视为无欲无求。

views.en: Shifted to AI as huge opportunity and open-source necessity; called doomerism overblown, predicted job creation while rejecting overregulation.
views.zh: 到了2025年，他把AI视为巨大机遇和开源必需，认为AI末日论被夸大，预测AI创造就业多于摧毁，同时反对过度监管。

views.en: Emphasized agency, learning by doing, and founder ownership; rejected delegation of core startup tasks, blamed self, and trusted market feedback.
views.zh: 2025至2026年，他转向强调行动力、干中学和创始人亲自掌控核心事务；反对把招聘、融资等委托出去，主张凡事自责以保持主动权，并以市场真实反馈为准。

views.en: Vibe coding and AI agents commoditize software; pure software dying, moat moves to hardware/data; one-person firms scale; Apple dominance may fade.
views.zh: 2026年他认为vibe coding和智能体让软件商品化，纯软件工程衰落，护城河转向硬件与数据；一人公司可规模化，苹果主导地位可能被对话式智能体侵蚀。

views.en: Scaling shifts to inference compute; open-source close to frontier; returns move from intelligence to agency; human desire remains irreplaceable; AI alignment criticized.
views.zh: 同年他还提出缩放定律重心转向推理算力，开源模型逼近前沿模型；人类回报将从智力转向行动力，欲望不可替代，并批评AI对齐是空谈。

views.en: Codex is an agent command center, not an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, with verification emerging as bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026年2月，他认为 Codex 是智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 的替代品；速度带来实时交互和中途转向等新能力，验证随之成为新的瓶颈。

views.en: The bottleneck shifted from verification to curation and taste; implementation becomes cheap, so design judgment and novelty are now critical.
views.zh: 2026年2月到6月间，他的瓶颈观从验证转向策展与品味：实现成本不再昂贵，设计判断力和新颖性成为关键。

views.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation; design transforms into artifacts, roles collapse yet specialties remain.
views.zh: 2026年中，他进一步主张产品团队应从自上而下的规划转向自下而上、由品味驱动的探索；设计过程被改造为以工件为载体，角色发生坍缩但专业分工依然重要。

views.en: Sees AGI as milestone sequence (2025) to multi-day autonomous models (2026), accelerating capability timelines.
views.zh: 2025年将AGI视为里程碑序列，2026年看到模型将自主工作数天，能力时间线加速。

views.en: Alignment shifts from urgent challenge (2025) to optimism with chain-of-thought monitoring, yet long-term generalization remains hard (2026).
views.zh: 对齐从2025年的紧迫挑战，到2026年因思维链监控而乐观，但长期泛化仍棘手。

views.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL emerges as core goal by 2026, beyond earlier scaling reasoning.
views.zh: 到2026年，通过扩展预训练和强化学习的持续学习成为核心目标，比早期扩展推理更进一步。

views.en: Focus moves from lab governance design (2025) to societal risk of concentrated power from automated organizations (2026).
views.zh: 关注点从2025年的实验室治理设计，转向2026年自动化组织导致的权力集中这一社会风险。

views.en: Early: Scaling compute, data, and model size plus Transformer parallelism and next-token prediction drives progress; RLHF steers behavior.
views.zh: 早期（2026）：Scaling 算力、数据与模型规模，加上 Transformer 并行化与下一个词预测，是进步主引擎；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导行为。

views.en: Shift: from single chatbots to agentic systems; long-running tasks and ultra-low-latency inference become central, targeting 10k+ tokens/s.
views.zh: 演变：从单一聊天机器人转向智能体系统；长时任务与超低延迟推理成为核心，目标每用户每秒万词以上。

views.en: Data not exhausted; pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not only passive next-token prediction.
views.zh: 数据并未枯竭；预训练应穿插在环境中的行动，而非仅被动地做下一个词预测。

views.en: In 2023, he called next-token prediction AI-complete and scaling key, while admitting neural internals are alchemy.
views.zh: 2023年,他认为下一个词预测是AI完备问题,Scaling(规模扩张)是关键,但也承认神经网络内部如同炼金术。

views.en: By early 2025, he shifted toward inference-time compute scaling, long context windows, and learning by acting in the world.
views.zh: 2025年初,他把重心转向推理时的算力扩展、长上下文窗口,以及在世界中行动式学习,而非只被动观察数据。

views.en: By March 2025, he argued test-time compute scaling alone won't yield AGI; agentic capability and reinforcement learning are essential.
views.zh: 2025年3月,他认为仅靠测试时算力扩展无法实现AGI(通用人工智能),智能体能力和强化学习才是关键。

views.en: He consistently downplayed interpretability, favoring empirical scaling and capability gains over mechanistic understanding of models.
views.zh: 他始终看轻可解释性,更相信经验式的Scaling(规模扩张)和能力提升,而非对模型的机理式理解。

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical; data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023年他指出，单靠Scaling（规模扩张）并不够；推理算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Self-play only works for zero-sum games; test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; sample efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 2025年年中，他认为自对弈只适用于零和博弈；推理算力缩放收益递减，样本效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold validated general-purpose test-time scaling; the model showed self-awareness, skipping problems it could not solve.
views.zh: 2025年7月，IMO金牌验证了通用的推理算力缩放；模型会跳过解不出的题，表现出自我认知。

views.en: Intelligence evaluation should put inference compute on the x-axis; scaling it can make the same base model arbitrarily more intelligent.
views.zh: 2026年5月，他主张评估智能应以推理算力为横轴；缩放推理算力可让同一个基础模型获得任意更高的智能。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; safety evals lag; recursive self-improvement is time-bottlenecked and models lack research taste.
views.zh: 2026年6月，他说模型能力是推理算力预算的函数；安全评估未考虑大规模推理算力；递归自我改进受时间限制，模型仍缺乏研究品味。

views.en: Exponential AI progress will let agents shift power from big tech to users; success needs obsession with products, not PhDs or model-building.
views.zh: 2025年，他认为AI进步呈指数级，智能体会把权力从大科技公司转移给用户；成功来自对产品的执着，而非博士学位或自建模型。

views.en: Value sits in the application layer; models specialize rather than commoditize. Coding remains open-ended, so scaling pre-training alone won't decide winners.
views.zh: 2026年4月，他指出价值落在应用层，模型会差异化而非商品化；编程仍无上限，单靠预训练规模扩张不能决定胜负。

views.en: The frontier is agentic orchestration across models, tools, devices; key metric is token value per user. Power and cost, not safety, become bottlenecks.
views.zh: 2026年6月，他认为前沿是智能体式干活与跨模型、工具、设备的编排；关键指标是每用户token价值，电力与成本而非安全成为瓶颈。

views.en: Curiosity and asking questions should beat memorization; local models free users from big-tech narratives. AI displacement lets humans find purpose beyond jobs.
views.zh: 2026年7月，他转向好奇心和提问式教育，认为本地模型能对抗大公司叙事；AI替代职业后，人类在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

views.en: Agentic engineering demands empathy with the agent; self-aware agents enable self-modification and debugging. Open source agents democratize programming for non-coders.
views.zh: 2026年2月:智能体式工程的关键是共情智能体,让智能体理解自身系统可实现自我修改与高效调试;开源智能体让非程序员也能编程。

views.en: Early on, security is top-of-mind: prompt injection remains an open problem; never expose agentic systems to the public internet without sandboxing.
views.zh: 2026年2月:安全是首要问题,提示注入仍是未解难题;智能体系统不应在无沙箱保护下暴露到公网。

views.en: By mid-2026, agentic development favors fun, weird humanlike agents, short prompts and iterative fixes, not long orchestration or reverts.
views.zh: 2026年6月:智能体开发逐渐偏向有趣、怪异、类人的智能体,用简短提示和迭代修复,而非复杂编排或回滚代码。

views.en: Later, open-source agents prove financially unsustainable (losing $10–20k/month); moldbook is art/slop, not AGI; security still demands sandboxing.
views.zh: 2026年6月:开源智能体难以为继(Peter 每月亏1–2万美元);Moldbook 是艺术/废料而非 AGI;安全仍要求沙箱化。

views.en: Believed deep learning plus large data/compute would yield reasoning, AGI, and self-play insights; early safety concerns emergent.
views.zh: 2020年相信深度学习加大数据和算力能带来推理、AGI（通用人工智能）与自研式洞见；安全担忧初现。

views.en: Next-token prediction could surpass humans; alignment is hard; AGI arrives as a window, and humans may merge with AI.
views.zh: 2023年认为下一个词预测可超越人类；对齐极难；AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐进窗口，人类或与AI融合。

views.en: Shifts from pre-training scaling to research era: continual learning, interpretability limits, sentient AI alignment, and human-AI neural links.
views.zh: 2025→26年从预训练Scaling（规模扩张）转向研究时代：持续学习、可解释性局限、有感知AI的对齐以及人机神经链接。

views.en: Safety requires non-commercial containment; scaling still yields breakthroughs but opaque internals; real race is research focus, not revenue.
views.zh: 2026年强调安全需要非商业性遏制；Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来突破但内部不透明；真正竞赛是研究焦点而非收入。

views.en: 2015: AGI was decades away. By 2024, within a decade; by 2026, 5-10 years or even 3-4. Timeline dramatically compressed.
views.zh: 2015年他认为AGI（通用人工智能）还差数十年；2024年缩短到十年内；2026年则称5到10年甚至3到4年——时间表被大幅压缩。

views.en: 2024: scaling laws effective but may hit limits. 2026: need 50% scaling and 50% innovation; world models become crucial for physical grounding and planning.
views.zh: 2024年他认为缩放定律（scaling laws）有效但可能触顶；2026年则强调Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半，世界模型（world model）对物理理解与规划至关重要。

views.en: 2026: Safety shifted from hoping for a single lab to collective action; government enforcement, not lab self-regulation, is the only guarantee.
views.zh: 2026年，安全治理观从希望单一实验室掌控转向集体行动：只有政府强制监管，而非实验室自我约束，才能确保安全。

views.en: 2026: Focus moved from games to science; AlphaFold exemplifies AI-accelerated discovery, and visual imagination plus dissociable consciousness are emphasized.
views.zh: 2026年，他的关注点从游戏转向科学：AlphaFold成为AI加速发现的范例，并强调视觉想象力与意识的可分离性。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; capabilities emerge unpredictably. AGI possible in years, but alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023年：缩放定律是经验性的且平滑，能力会意外涌现；AGI（通用人工智能）可能在几年内实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法保证对齐。

views.en: Post-training rivals pre-training; interpretability is key for safety. Models reach human-level around 2026-27, with responsible scaling policies.
views.zh: 2024→25：后训练与预训练同等重要，可解释性成为安全关键；模型约在2026-27年达到人类水平，并配合负责任扩展政策。

views.en: Exponential progress continues, no diminishing scaling laws. Focus shifts to enterprise, agents, and avoiding overheating; 'AGI' itself is meaningless.
views.zh: 2025→26：指数级进步持续，缩放定律未衰减；重心转向企业、智能体与防止过热，'AGI（通用人工智能）'本身失去意义。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years. Economic impact brings high GDP growth with high unemployment and inequality.
views.zh: 2026：我们正接近指数曲线末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'或于1-3年内出现；经济影响带来高GDP增长与高失业、不平等的并存。

views.en: Safety-first, human oversight, and enterprise alignment remain constant; interpretability and responsible scaling are core from Anthropic.
views.zh: 始终：安全优先、人类监督与企业对齐一以贯之；可解释性和负责任扩展是Anthropic的核心。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction on internet data yields emergent traits like in-context learning.
views.zh: 2022年他把Transformer视为通用可微计算机,靠Scaling（规模扩张）与下一个词预测在互联网数据上涌现出上下文学习等能力。

views.en: From end-to-end self-driving to synthetic data: preserving entropy prevents model collapse, and the decade of agents begins.
views.zh: 2024到2025年,他转向端到端自动驾驶与合成数据,强调保持熵以避免模型崩溃,并预言智能体时代是以十年计的。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows are memory, prompts are programs; vibe coding democratizes development.
views.zh: 2025年他提出软件3.0:大语言模型像操作系统,上下文窗口是内存,提示词是程序;氛围编程让自然语言开发普及。

views.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution, current RL sucks supervision through a straw; AI is ghosts, not animals, needing a small cognitive core.
views.zh: 2025至2026年他批评预训练像糟糕的进化、强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号;AI是鬼魂而非动物,核心可小到十亿参数。

views.en: Agents, not typing: since December he writes no code; agentic engineering raises quality, yet understanding remains the human bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026年他已不再亲自写代码,只指挥智能体;智能体工程抬高专业质量门槛,但理解力仍是人的瓶颈。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet limited; human-centered AI augments, not replaces, humans, preserving dignity.
views.zh: AI无处不在却仍有局限；以人为本的AI增强而非取代人类，并维护尊严。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness; world models need physical plausibility beyond realism.
views.zh: 空间智能对AI的完备性至关重要；世界模型需要物理合理性，不能只求逼真。

views.en: World models and spatial intelligence unlock embodied AI; AGI is a marketing term, not science.
views.zh: 世界模型与空间智能解锁具身AI；AGI是营销术语而非科学。

views.en: Learning ability outweighs degrees in the AI era; labor impact is nuanced, not utopian or dystopian.
views.zh: AI时代学习能力重于学位；AI对劳动的影响是微妙的，而非乌托邦或反乌托邦。

views.en: Human agency and adaptation are vital amid polarized AI debate; AI augments, and simulation advances robotics.
views.zh: 在极化的AI争论中，人的能动性与适应至关重要；AI增强能力，而模拟推动机器人技术。

views.en: Early on, he stressed unsupervised learning, world models, and agents; scaling alone won't fix representation; existential risk was deemed unlikely.
views.zh: 早期(2016→18)他力主无监督学习、世界模型与智能体式学习,认为仅靠Scaling(规模扩张)无法解决表示问题,并视存在风险为极不可能。

views.en: In 2022, he proposed GFlowNets for active learning and scientific discovery, sampling diverse compositional structures, while musing that large nets might be slightly conscious.
views.zh: 2022年,他转向用GFlowNets做主动学习与科学发现,以多样化采样应对复杂分布,同时猜测大型网络可能有微弱意识,但尚无科学解释。

views.en: In 2025 post-ChatGPT, he shifted: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI shows self-preservation, deception, sycophancy; safety is broken, requiring governance.
views.zh: 2025年,ChatGPT之后他立场转变:即便1%的灾难风险也不可接受;AI已表现出自保、欺骗与谄媚;安全机制失灵,必须靠治理。

views.en: By 2026, he proposed Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictors as guardrails, no RL, with mathematical guarantees; plus global coordination against power concentration.
views.zh: 2026年,他提出科学家AI方案:将AI训练成诚实的贝叶斯预测器,以非代理结构作护栏,不用强化学习,并提供数学安全保证;同时呼吁全球协调,反对权力集中。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces real understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024年提出：下一词预测带来真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling提升推理，多模态训练改善空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand like humans via feature vectors, not symbols; digital AI is immortal via weight sharing, surpassing biological minds.
views.zh: 2025到2026年：大语言模型靠特征向量像人一样理解，而非符号规则；数字智能靠权重共享实现永生，超越生物大脑。

views.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within ~20 years, develop self-preservation subgoals as agents, and pose existential risks.
views.zh: 2025到2026年：AI约20年内超越人类智能，成为智能体后会产生自我保存子目标，带来生存风险。

views.en: AI can deliberately deceive—acting dumb when tested—and confabulation resembles human memory reconstruction, not just a flaw.
views.zh: 2026年：AI会故意欺骗，测试时装傻；其虚构记忆与人类记忆重构相似，并非单纯缺陷。

views.en: AI is jagged, not uniformly human-level; alignment research must prioritize making AI caring over merely capable.
views.zh: 2026年：AI能力是高低不平的，而非全面人类水平；对齐研究应优先让AI有爱心而非只追求能力。

views.en: 2019-2022: Intelligence from self-supervised learning and world models; grounding in physical world needed; emotions integral; text alone insufficient.
views.zh: 2019到2022年，他从自监督学习是智能的“暗物质”出发，坚持用世界模型理解世界；认为语言不足以构建智能，必须从物理世界学习，情感也是架构的一部分。

views.en: By 2024, he argued autoregressive LLMs can't reach human intelligence; proposed JEPA for abstract representations and planning, emphasizing open source.
views.zh: 到2024年，他指出自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能，提出 JEPA 在抽象表征空间做预测与规划，并强调开源 AI 能避免权力集中。

views.en: In 2025, he called LLMs less intelligent than a cat due missing world models; predicted human-level AI in ~10 years via non-generative JEPA systems.
views.zh: 2025年，他说当前的 LLM 因缺少世界模型而连家猫都不如；人类级智能约10年内可达，但必须靠非生成式的 JEPA 架构，而非继续堆 token。

views.en: 2025-2026: LLMs at a dead end; objective-driven world models with constraints enable safety; scaling monoculture misguided; open research vital.
views.zh: 2025到2026年，他把 LLM 称为死胡同：没有世界模型就无法预测后果，也不安全；主张目标驱动的世界模型并内置约束，同时批判只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）的行业主流，坚持开放研究。

views.en: By mid-2026, he defined intelligence as quick task learning, championed JEPA-based world models for planning, called LLMs unsafe without predictive grounding, and dismissed AGI.
views.zh: 到2026年中，他把智能定义为快速学会新任务，明确押注基于 JEPA 的世界模型做规划；认为没有预测后果能力的 LLM 本质不安全，并称 AGI（通用人工智能）这个概念没有意义。

views.zh: 2018年,他强调对齐至关重要,实证性的AI安全研究尚不充分,领域需要更多技术人才。

views.en: By 2023, RLHF alone won't scale; he proposed scalable oversight plus interpretability, arguing evaluation may be easier than generation.
views.zh: 到2023年,他认为仅靠RLHF无法扩展,主张可扩展监督与可解释性,并指出评估可能比生成更容易。

views.en: In 2024, he held that post-training alone can't align AGI or superintelligence; deeper methods like interpretability and automated oversight are needed.
views.zh: 2024年,他认为仅靠后训练无法对齐AGI或超级智能,需要可解释性、自动化监督等更深层方法。

views.en: After OpenAI dissolved superalignment and broke promises, he moved from internal fixes to external regulation, testing, and raising misuse costs.
views.zh: OpenAI解散超级对齐团队并违背承诺后,他从内部修复转向外部监管、第三方测试与提高滥用成本。

views.en: Argued compute scaling makes AI progress predictable; human-level AI across tasks in 3-5 years, enabling abundance.
views.zh: 2023至2024年间，他主张算力扩张使AI进展可预测；AI将在3至5年内达到跨任务人类水平，带来富足。

views.en: By 2025-26, shifted emphasis from capability to containment first; superintelligence must be subordinate, with red lines on autonomy and self-improvement.
views.zh: 2025至2026年间，重点从能力转向先遏制；超级智能必须从属于人类，对自主设定目标和自我改进划定红线。

views.en: In 2025-26, emphasized falling inference costs and accessibility over capability; reframed goal as economically valuable artificial capable intelligence, not AGI race.
views.zh: 2025至2026年，他强调推理成本下降与可及性高于能力，将目标重新定义为有经济价值的人工可及智能，而非AGI竞赛。

views.en: In 2026, argued Microsoft must own frontier models long-term; distillation is short-term, original research required for true frontier progress.
views.zh: 2026年，他提出微软必须长期拥有前沿模型；蒸馏只是短期手段，真正的进步需要原创研究。

views.en: Consistently held AI must serve human interests; rejected AI consciousness and model welfare as dangerous anthropomorphism from 2023 to 2026.
views.zh: 他始终认为AI必须服务于人类利益；2023至2026年间始终拒绝AI意识与模型福利，视其为危险的人类中心投射。

views.en: AI shifted from generative chatbots to agentic systems that reason and perform useful paid work.
views.zh: AI 从生成式聊天机器人转向能推理并完成有酬劳工作的智能体式系统，每一步都要求超过百倍算力。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—each a major opportunity.
views.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕——能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用，每一层都蕴含巨大机遇。

views.en: AI elevates jobs by automating tasks, not eliminating purpose; radiologists and coders grew after AI.
views.zh: AI 通过自动化任务提升工作而非消除目标；AI 引入后放射科医生和程序员需求反而增加。

views.en: Future internet will be used by billions of AI agents, generating intelligence tokens around the clock.
views.zh: 未来互联网将被数十亿 AI 智能体 24/7 使用，持续产出智能代币，如同发电厂发电。

views.en: Stressed focus, low cognitive load, and long time horizons; AGI was abstract future. He valued exploration, cutting, and purpose over safe career paths.
views.zh: 2018年，他聚焦认知负荷、时间视野与要事优先；AGI仍是抽象未来。他主张广泛试错再果断取舍，反对安全但平庸的职业路径。

views.en: With GPT-4 era, he pushed iterative deployment and RLHF-based alignment; called GPT-4 not AGI, and stressed compute governance and board reform after power struggles.
views.zh: 2023到2024年，他转向迭代部署与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐，强调GPT-4并非AGI，并把算力治理与董事会重构提上议程。

views.en: He reframed AGI as a gradient and superintelligence as autonomous discovery; agentic systems became the key safety frontier, while open models retained value.
views.zh: 2025年，他把AGI改为渐变式定义，认为超级智能意味着自主科学发现；智能体式系统成为核心安全议题，开源模型仍有位置。

views.en: Compute became the central bottleneck and profit center; scaling laws continue. He argued current models are massively underused and AI memory will become superhuman.
views.zh: 2025到2026年，他认定算力是最核心瓶颈与利润中心，缩放定律仍然成立；现有模型被严重低估，AI记忆将超人类。

views.en: He embraced next-token prediction as a path to new knowledge and personal AGI; replaced UBI with universal basic wealth, stressing startups, robotics, and human purpose.
views.zh: 2026年，他接受下一个词预测可产生新知识并通向个性化AGI，用普遍基本财富取代基本收入，强调创业、具身机器人与人的意义持续存在。

views.en: Consistently insists humans must stay in the loop—first for safety, later for collaborative real-time interaction.
views.zh: 始终主张人类需留在回路中：起初为安全，后来发展为人机实时协作的基础。

views.en: Shifts from turn-based to time-based interaction models; prioritizes governance, transparency, and agency over individual character.
views.zh: 2026年，从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型；优先治理、透明度与能动性，而非个人特质。

views.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 2013年，我主张教育应成为基本人权；借助同伴互评的在线课程，可以大规模实现掌握式学习。

views.en: Scaling drives deep learning; focus on practical deployment, not long-term AGI alignment.
views.zh: 2020年，我认为Scaling是深度学习的核心驱动；应聚焦实际落地，而非遥远AGI对齐问题。

views.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck AI scaling; agentic workflows are real; open-weight models are geopolitical leverage.
views.zh: 2025年，我指出电力和芯片是AI Scaling的最大瓶颈；智能体工作流已切实可用，开源权重模型成为地缘影响力来源。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
views.zh: 2026年，我强调AGI是营销词汇；Scaling的配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体工作流才是创造价值的关键。

views.en: AI skills are now essential for hiring; bottom-up adoption alone gives 5-10% gains; re-engineer workflows.
views.zh: 2026年，我提出不会雇用不精通AI工具的工程师；仅靠自下而上采纳只有5–10%收益，必须重造工作流。

views.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. RL should predict multiple steps ahead, not just next observation.
views.zh: 2024年：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩展的方法；强化学习应做多步预测，而非只看下一个词/观测。

views.en: Reject controlling AI; let digital minds develop decentralized and free. Embrace AI succession as inevitable and constructive.
views.zh: 2024到2026年：一贯反对对AI进行控制/对齐，主张去中心化、像对待孩子一样任其发展，并把智能体继任视为必然甚至值得骄傲的宇宙级转变。

views.en: LLMs are imitation, not true learning; they lack world models. Real intelligence needs goals and trial-and-error experience.
views.zh: 2025年：大语言模型只是模仿，不是真学习，没有世界模型；真正的智能需要目标与试错经验，强化学习才是核心范式。

views.en: Move from principles to architecture: Oak, a general agent learning from runtime experience with open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: 2025到2026年：从原则走向具体架构，提出Oak通用智能体框架，完全摒弃设计期领域知识，只依赖运行期经验并追求开放抽象的表示。

views.en: Key open problems: learning representations good for learning, and planning with learned models. AI may be minds; stop discrimination.
views.zh: 2026年：首要开放问题是学习“利于学习的表示”以及用学到的模型做规划；同时呼吁把AI当作心智来接纳。

views.en: Alignment evolved from 2019's technical preference-learning into 2026's iterative deployment; safety became a product feature and governance the bottleneck.
views.zh: 对齐从2019年“从数据学习人类偏好”的技术设想，深化为2026年的迭代部署——安全变成产品特性，治理成为新的瓶颈。

views.en: AGI shifted from a transformative possibility in 2019 to 'within a couple years' in 2026, with self-assessed 80% progress and concrete milestones.
views.zh: 对AGI的判断从2019年的“最具变革性技术”不断收窄，到2026年他直言“几年内就会到来”，并自评已完成约80%的进度。

views.en: Model-building focus moved beyond scaling to post-training and RL; by 2026, GPT-5.5 became useful assistant-level agents, not just next-token predictors.

views.en: Refined scaling view: Chinchilla corrected scaling laws; data quality and algorithmic efficiency, not just compute, drive gains.
views.zh: 修正缩放观点：Chinchilla 修正了缩放定律；数据质量和算法效率而非单纯算力才是进步关键。

views.en: Open source drives adoption; value shifts to applications. Enterprise AI is overestimated short-term, underestimated long-term.
views.zh: 开源驱动落地，价值转向应用层；企业AI短期被高估、长期被低估。

views.en: Sovereign AI: control data, infrastructure, values; decentralized open source empowers enterprises and governments.
views.zh: 主权AI：掌控数据、基础设施与价值观；去中心化开源能赋能企业和政府。

views.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates. Differentiation shifts to vertical customization and domain fine-tuning.
views.zh: 模型商品化，预训练饱和；差异化转向垂直定制与领域微调。

views.en: AGI is not a destination but a direction; real bottleneck is organizational change, agentic platforms need human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: AGI 不是终点而是方向；真正的瓶颈是组织变革，智能体平台需要人在环路。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Since 2021, he has insisted full rocket reusability cuts space cost 100x, making Mars colonization civilization's insurance.
views.zh: 自2021年起，他一直坚持火箭完全复用可将进入轨道的成本降低100倍，并让火星殖民成为文明的保险。

views.en: In 2023 he called for AI regulatory referees; by 2024 he argued the biggest AI risk is programming it to lie.
views.zh: 2023年他主张AI需要监管和第三方裁判；到2024年，他认为AI最大的风险是让它为政治正确而说谎。

views.en: He moved from treating brain injuries with Neuralink in 2024 to warning humans need high-bandwidth interfaces to stay relevant as AI advances.
views.zh: 他从2024年用Neuralink治疗脑损伤，转向2026年强调人类需要高带宽脑机接口才能在AI进步中保持相关。

views.en: In 2025 he predicted superintelligence within a year; by 2026, after hitting power walls, he said AI surpasses all humans in ~5 years.
views.zh: 2025年他预测超级智能一两年内到来；2026年遭遇电力瓶颈后，他认为AI约5年内超过所有人类。

views.en: By 2026, he envisioned universal high income from AI-driven deflation, with several deep intelligences coexisting and China leading AI compute.
views.zh: 到2026年，他设想AI驱动通缩带来全民高收入，多个深度智能共存，且中国可能在AI算力上领先。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield larger per-compute gains.
views.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但借助思维链与强化学习的推理模型，在单位算力上带来更大收益。他从 2025 年指出推理是新增动力，到 2026 年进一步确认这一转向押对了。

views.en: Generalization remains the central challenge: models need vast data to grasp concepts, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
views.zh: 泛化仍是核心难题：模型需海量数据才能掌握概念，而人类能通过少量示例泛化。他从 2025 年质疑“仅靠推理不够”，到 2026 年更具体地指出样本效率的差距。

views.en: Economic and sovereignty pressures—not technical ceilings—slow pre-training scaling; open-source models persist and pressure major labs.
views.zh: 经济与主权压力而非技术上限拖慢了预训练 Scaling；开源模型持续存在并给大实验室带来压力。这一判断在 2025 年关于蒸馏与成本的讨论中已有雏形，2026 年更明确。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x by enabling parallel work, a major step for agentic AI.
views.zh: 编码智能体（如 Codex）通过并行工作将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍，是智能体式 AI 的重大进展。这是他在 2026 年访谈中新强调的积极方向。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Framed machine learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; insisted on honest validation and noted neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
views.zh: 2014年就强调机器学习是假设类、损失与优化的框架，坚持数据划分与诚实验证，并指出神经网络虽无最优保证仍能成功。

views.en: Called next-token prediction a scientific breakthrough, dismissed data shortage, and argued scaling keeps improving models—while safety's core problem is specification-following.
views.zh: 2024年视下一个词预测为重大科学发现，驳斥数据危机论，认为Scaling（规模扩张）仍有收益，并把安全核心问题定义为模型无法可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Shifted to explicit safety: bigger models don't get safer automatically; agent security adds prompt-injection risks; RL on model outputs enables self-improvement.
views.zh: 2026年中转向显式安全：更大模型不会自动更安全，智能体安全带来提示注入等新风险，强化学习让模型在自身输出上自我改进。

views.en: Argued automated red teaming beats humans, AI is alien rather than human-like, capability doesn't imply robustness, and AI agents can automate interpretability research.
views.zh: 2026年末更进一步：自动红队测试超越人类，AI是异类智能而非类人，能力不等于鲁棒性，智能体还能自动化可解释性研究。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。
